scope: Previously evaluated Test predictions; descriptive analysis only
aggregation: Mean across visits within each patient, then equal mean across six patients; OAR counts pooled within patient before calculating the rate

definitions.apex_central_base_slice_dice: Mean GT-positive slice Dice in physically ordered inferior 20%, central region, superior 20%; geometric proxies, not clinician-annotated endpoints
definitions.visits_with_internal_prostate_gap_fracti: Fraction of visits with an empty predicted Z slice between nonempty predicted prostate slices; patient-equal mean
definitions.area_transition_absolute_error: Absolute difference between mean normalized adjacent-area changes of prediction and GT, on GT-positive adjacent pairs; mean within patient then across patients; dimensionless proxy
definitions.true_oar_labelled_prostate_fraction: GT Bladder/Rectum voxels predicted as Prostate divided by all GT Bladder/Rectum voxels, pooled within patient then averaged; not a wall-specific or dose metric
